messages:
hana: Heads-up — onboarding Grandis LoRA (customer) into raven-3b pipeline. merged adapter + quant int4 -> quick smoke showed token misalignment on short prompts with emojis. can someone help triage?

jaya: taking a look. Do you have the exact merge command and the eval pack you ran?

hana: repro steps below:
```bash
# merge and quantize
python tools/merge_lora.py --base models/raven-3b --lora grandis/lora_v1 --out builds/raven-3b-grandis
python tools/quantize.py builds/raven-3b-grandis --mode int4 --out builds/raven-3b-grandis-int4
ri-infer serve --model builds/raven-3b-grandis-int4 --port 8080
```
Observed: with prompt `\"Translate: Hello 👋 ->` output sometimes drops emoji token and shifts following tokens (short completions only).

matt: can you paste the server logs for one of the failing runs? Also which kernel backend did the quantizer pick? (A100-cuda vs aten-opt)

hana: log snippet attached (paste):
```
[2026-03-19T14:02:11Z] infer: request id=gc-3421 len=8 seq=1
[2026-03-19T14:02:11Z] runtime: kv_cache_mismatch detected at step 12 for batch 0
[2026-03-19T14:02:11Z] runtime: fallback to slower path (aten-opt)
[2026-03-19T14:02:11Z] infer: produced tokens: ["Hello", " ", "\uFFFD", "friend"]
```
The quantizer picked `flash-attn-fused` kernels by default but we fell back on aten-opt during the run.

jaya: kv_cache_mismatch usually points to tokenization vs cache indexing disagreement after merging adapter weights — especially if adapter changed embedding offsets. Did you remap token embeddings?

hana: we used the standard merge script without remapping. Grandis LoRA was trained on customer tokenizer (some extra tokens for product names).

santiago: customer acceptance requirement: <2% regression on intent accuracy, and no emoji/tokenization shuffles in short UI flows. They test with 200 short prompts.

matt: quick hypothesis: LoRA introduced new tokens that shifted encoding table indices. In int4 path we rely on stable embedding offsets; remapping must be applied before quant.

jaya: propose quick eval pack: 200 short prompts (customer set) + 50 safety prompts + tokenizer delta check. I'll assemble and run on both float16 baseline and the merged int4.

hana: thanks — attached a tiny diff of tokenizer vocab head (first 32 entries) — Grandis added two tokens at index 5-6.

jaya: that explains it. Plan:
1) re-run merge with tokenizer remap: `tools/remap_vocab.py --base models/raven-3b/tokenizer.json --addon grandis/tokenizer.json --out remapped_tokenizer.json`
2) rebuild model with remapped tokenizer and quantize
3) run quick eval pack and compare metrics (intent ACC, perplexity, emoji-token-match-rate)

matt: I'll add an infra check to prevent running int4 runtime that falls back to aten-opt without emitting a hard warning — fallback path is fine but we need a regression flag. I filed infra ticket #INF-6789.

ehana: (typo) meant hana: I kicked off remap + quant locally, getting build taking ~9m on dev A100. Will post results.

eval-bot: queued quick-eval job qi-5543: comparing builds/raven-3b-baseline-fp16 -> builds/raven-3b-grandis-int4-remap. Estimated run 4m.

jaya: sample quick results (after remap + rebuild):
- intent_acc: baseline=0.923, remap-int4=0.919 (delta -0.4%)
- ppl (short prompts): baseline=6.1, remap-int4=6.4
- emoji-token-match-rate: baseline=100/100, remap-int4=99/100 (one mismatch previously)
- kv_cache_mismatch events: baseline=0, remap-int4=0

santiago: that’s within acceptance. Customer wants a small run on their 200 prompt suite before we flip canary.

hana: sending the canary build to customer staging (staging-grandis) and request run. Also adding a prompt hook to detect token shifts during warmstart.

jaya: note for records: update merge_lora docs to call out tokenizer remap step when adapter vocab != base vocab. I can PR.

matt: added a quick CI check to ensure quantizer kernel selection is deterministic and to warn if fallback occurs: PR #4256.

eval-bot: quick-eval qi-5543 completed: full report uploaded to /evals/qi-5543.

santiago: great work — once customer confirms we can promote to Dedicated staging. thanks team :thumbsup:

hana: thanks all, closing triage.
